usr_sunita_pawar_01.title: Market Footfall & Taste Test Survey
usr_sunita_pawar_01.description: Visit the Shirur bus station and market junction between 7:30 AM – 9:30 AM. Observe how many people buy morning tea and poha, and note their prices (typically ₹10 tea, ₹20 poha).
materialsNeeded: Sample poha to offer 5 family neighbors for feedback

usr_sunita_pawar_01.title: Lock Stall Location & Landowner / Panchayat Permission
usr_sunita_pawar_01.description: Find a safe, clean 6x4 feet dry spot with customer shade. Confirm with the shopfront owner or Gram Panchayat that morning stall placement is permitted.

usr_sunita_pawar_01.title: Collect Itemized Equipment Quotations
usr_sunita_pawar_01.description: Get written estimates from 2 utensil shops in Shirur for 1 commercial gas stove, regulator, 10L tea kettle, 3 stainless steel trays, and 50 reusable washable cups or paper cups.

usr_sunita_pawar_01.title: Calculate 7-Day Ingredient Working Capital
usr_sunita_pawar_01.description: List initial ingredients: 5kg tea leaves, 15kg sugar, 20L milk estimate, 10kg poha, spices, and cooking oil. Total 7-day reserve needed: ~₹4,500.

usr_sunita_pawar_01.title: Apply for Mudra Shishu Loan at Local Bank Branch
usr_sunita_pawar_01.description: Submit Mudra Shishu 1-page form along with Aadhaar, passbook copy, and the equipment quotation to Bank of Maharashtra Shirur branch for ₹20,000 - ₹30,000 support.

usr_sunita_pawar_01.title: FSSAI Basic Food Registration Application
usr_sunita_pawar_01.description: Apply for FSSAI registration certificate on FoSCoS portal (₹100 annual fee) to operate legally and build customer hygiene trust.

usr_sunita_pawar_01.title: Trial Run with Neighbors & Family (Soft Launch)
usr_sunita_pawar_01.description: Prepare test batches of spiced masala tea and hot poha at home. Practice boiling speed, spice measurements, packaging, and clean water handling.

usr_sunita_pawar_01.title: Stall Opening Day & QR Code Payment Setup
usr_sunita_pawar_01.description: Set up stall with clean banner, offer free taste cups to first 20 passers-by, display PhonePe / GPay QR code for easy UPI payments, and record day 1 cash balance.
